title: IED host settings
description: The settings the host itself declares (docs/07 "Host settings"), next to the plugins'. Owner 'ied'.

lsp.idleStopMinutes.description: A language server none of whose documents a window shows for this many minutes stops, giving back its memory; it starts again when one of its documents is shown or asked about (docs/24). 0 keeps servers running.

keyboard.bindings.description: The owner's keyboard shortcuts, over the shell's and the plugins' (Settings > Environment > Keyboard): each adds a key to a command, or with `remove` takes a default key (or every default key, without `key`) off it.

key.description: A key or a chord as docs/15 "Commands and keys" writes them: 'ctrl+k ctrl+c'.

configServer.url.description: A config server to follow (docs/35): its settings become the Shared tier, under yours, and its plugins and skills are mirrored into the app data's shared folder. 'https://nas.lan:8780/'; empty follows none.

configServer.token.description: The config server's reader token, never in a settings file: { "env": "IED_CONFIG_TOKEN" } names the environment variable that holds it ({ "secret": "<name>" } waits for the secret store, docs/11).

configServer.certificate.description: A PEM file of CA certificates trusted for the config server's https besides the system's (a NAS's own CA); empty trusts the system's alone.
